item.title: Supermail 0.2.2041
item.description:
• Quoted lines in plain-text emails read as quotes, not "> " lines
  • The All Inboxes tab is just its name and count, with no icon
  • Folders of your own for the automations; Tax forms inside Money on the Mac too
  • Web and email addresses show as links even when an email styles them like text
  • All Inboxes is a tab left of Inbox
  • Costs page in Postal Admin shows what Claude and EasyPost cost
  • ↑ into a long email above lands on its end, not its top
  • One Claude search covers every signed-in inbox (staff Mac app)
  • Row and reader buttons show their tooltip after a fifth of a second
  • An email can't make Supermail fetch an attachment it names
  • Rows with an unsent draft say Draft, like Gmail
  • A file dropped on a draft's text attaches instead of going in as a link
  • Cmd+U sends a footer's unsubscribe email link
  • Email pictures never load from private addresses or plain http
  • Requests to Google carry and keep no cookies
  • The offline note says Supermail in the public app
  • Real delivery status from UPS, FedEx, USPS and DHL through EasyPost
  • Mail through your own group or a teammate's conversation stays in Inbox, and Always Inbox / Always FYI for a sender
  • A sign-in page's error reaches the log only as a code
  • A refused iPhone sign-in logs only Google's error code
  • Postal works offline on Mac and iPhone
  • The email keeps its room above a reply, and an email never opens on an empty page
  • A narrow window moves the email's buttons above its subject
  • Keep zoomed emails from collapsing to zero height
  • The staff email and What's New say who shipped each change
  • Recent emails in the side panel open when clicked, Esc comes back
  • FYI tab after Inbox for mail that needs no reply
  • An email whose text won't download tries again, then says so with Try again
  • Gmail's categories as Postal Labels, and Always Important / Always Other per sender
  • Copies stay on device, sign-in errors log codes only
